model_name: Selected-population beta joint law with explicit transported associations

design.sampling: Each cell has fixed count; ages are independent discrete-uniform integers within the cell. Remaining draws are independent across people given covariates. Cells appear in female-then-age-band order; order is not a covariate.
design.weighting: Equal-cell WLS gives each cell mass 1/8. With 375 rows per cell each row weight is 1/3000; coefficients equal unweighted OLS. This is not national-survey estimation.

population.description: Mexico analytical-use adults aged 25-79 with no reported previous doctor diagnosis of diabetes/high blood sugar, recorded 8-12-hour fast, positive fasting serum glucose below 126 mg/dL, available HbA1c and valid standing anthropometry with internally consistent measurement documentation; uniformly exclude explicit not-weighed or alternative-standing-route documentation that contradicts usable standing measurements without asserting which field is correct. Pregnancy/lactation excluded when documented by questionnaire routing in women aged 25-49. No verified medication or anemia exclusion.
population.selection_assumption: The modeled law is conditional on eligibility already having been satisfied. Diagnosis, fasting duration, pregnancy/lactation, medication, anemia and anthropometry documentation are not generated columns, cannot be verified per fictional row, and are not recovered from people. No HbA1c-based diabetes exclusion is imposed.
population.measurement: BMI in kg/m^2, glucose in serum mg/dL, HbA1c in percent. Values represent recorded measurements including unresolved biological and measurement variation, not noiseless latent physiology.

unit_conversion.basis: Conventional rounded glucose molecular-mass unit conversion; a conversion convention, not an estimated association.

bmi.law: BMI=lower+(upper-lower)*Beta(alpha,beta), independent of age and female. For p=(mean-lower)/(upper-lower), k=(mean-lower)*(upper-mean)/sd^2-1, alpha=p*k and beta=(1-p)*k.

glucose.law: gA=-(-0.1985)*18/17.5=0.2041714285714286 mg/dL/year; gB=0.024*18=0.432 mg/dL per kg/m^2; gF=-0.2472*18=-4.4496 mg/dL. mG=94+gA*(age-50)+gB*(BMI-28.01)+gF*(female-0.5). Draw scaled Beta on (45,126) parameterized by conditional mean mG and conditional SD 10 via the same moment formula as BMI. Thus E(G|A,F,B)=mG and Var(G|A,F,B)=100 in the mathematical law. This is a selected-population density, not a normal draw clamped at 126. np.nextafter protects the strict upper bound against floating-point endpoint rounding only.

hba1c.law: hB=0.0125-0.01*gB=0.00818 percentage points per kg/m^2; hF=0.023-0.01*gF=0.067496 percentage points. mH=5.45+0.01*(age-50)+hB*(BMI-28.01)+hF*(female-0.5)+0.01*(glucose-94). Draw H=mH+0.32*sqrt(2*4+1)*(2*V-1), V~Beta(4,4), independent of all previous draws. Residual mean is zero, variance is 0.1024 percentage-points squared, and support is (-0.96,0.96). No outcome clipping, rounding, eligibility rejection or sample recentering is used.

joint_law.factorization: Fixed equal-cell design times P(age|cell) P(BMI) P(glucose|age,female,BMI) P(HbA1c|age,female,BMI,glucose). Independent innovations do not imply independent biomarkers: glucose and HbA1c share age, BMI and female associations, with an additional conditional glucose-HbA1c association.
joint_law.causal_status: A statistical factorization for synthetic data, not a causal graph. The Q2-Q3 difference is omitted-variable algebra under this law; it does not estimate biological mediation.
joint_law.missing_relations: No supplied source identifies the full Mexico joint law or a transportable glucose-adjusted BMI coefficient. A conditional glucose slope of 0.01 is an explicit scenario. Constant effects, BMI independence of age/female, homoscedasticity, residual independence and all tail shapes are assumptions, not inferred null findings.
joint_law.uncertainty: Parameters are fixed source point choices or declared assumptions. Seeds vary individuals only; they do not represent source-estimate uncertainty, population-transfer uncertainty or model probabilities. No source SE is used as individual SD, no uncertainty intervals are fabricated, and no seed is selected for its results.

support_and_tail_justification.bmi: Bounded beta gives a right-skewed BMI distribution with finite moments and nonzero conditional variation. Bounds 14 and 55 are developmental support assumptions, not empirical minima/maxima or eligibility rules; extreme wasting and extreme obesity beyond these values are unmodeled.
support_and_tail_justification.glucose: A conditional beta includes variability close to 126 while satisfying eligibility without a point mass from clipping. The lower bound 45 is assumed, not an additional task eligibility restriction. Exact density and boundary-tail probabilities are unvalidated. With current covariate support the conditional mean ranges 80.6185942857143-113.80545142857143; shape parameters are positive. Boundary behavior must be inspected in isolated draws.
support_and_tail_justification.hba1c: Bounded symmetric beta innovations maintain a linear conditional mean with finite positive measurements. The full mathematical support lies inside 3.6016502-7.2745262 percent. Values above 6.5 are permitted. The law does not represent all possible anemia, medication, assay or diabetes-discordant tails; it must not support clinical-tail prevalence claims.
support_and_tail_justification.finite_precision: The tiny glucose upper-endpoint safeguard may differ from the ideal continuous moments by floating-point precision; it is not a clinical truncation procedure.

permitted_use: Developmental inspection and demonstration of the three specified equal-cell regressions under an explicit evidence-informed scenario. No representative Mexico estimates, causal inference, diagnostic decisions, clinical power guarantees or claims of empirical/clinical validation.
